newsitem.title: UK: Royal Bank gains as report sparks bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank gains as report sparks bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Royal Bank of Scotland Plc rose in early trade on Tuesday, shrugging off weakness elsewhere in the UK equity market as a press report said the group could be a bid target for HSBC Holdings Plc.
Royal Bank shares were up 9p at 592 by 0735 GMT, one of only two shares in the FTSE 100 index to show an advance after a 2-1/2 percent tumble in the U.S. Dow Industrials index overnight.
HSBC shares were unchanged at 18.28-1/2 stg.
The Times said HSBC "is believed to be poised for a takeover strike" on the Royal Bank and could fund the acquisition largely from its 4 billion stg mountain of surplus capital.

The paper said the merger of the Royal Bank with HSBC's Midland Bank would pose none of the competition concerns that would be likely to dog other recently-rumoured bids in the financial sector, such as a bid for National Westminster Bank Plc from Barclays Plc.
Spokesman for both HSBC and the Royal Bank said they had no comment on market speculation.
